system.notes: Vehicle Skill for piloting, navigating and handling a large surface ship (Cyberpirates ship rules — not automated). Defaults to Motorboat, one dot (+2 default) — apply by hand. Concentrations: Diesel (SV), Nuclear (SV), Turbine (SV); specializing means a specific class of vessel. Related new concentrations of existing skills: Armed/Unarmed Combat (Underwater) — −1 Combat Skill for surface melee; Etiquette (Maritime).
